Resolves #19148
Refs #18985

Pins `Neo.util.Css.insertRules(windowId, rules)` and `Neo.util.Css.deleteRules(windowId, rules)` in `test/playwright/unit/util/Css.spec.mjs`, verifying that array and scalar rule arguments are normalized into arrays and forwarded with `windowId` to `Neo.main.addon.Stylesheet.insertCssRules` and `Neo.main.addon.Stylesheet.deleteCssRules`, while restoring `Neo.main.addon.Stylesheet` after each test so `Stylesheet.spec.mjs` never hits a `unitTestMode` namespace collision.

Evidence: L1 (Playwright single-thread unit test suite in Node.js) → L1 required (AC-1 through AC-5).

Micro-review eligible: test-only — adds one unit spec (`test/playwright/unit/util/Css.spec.mjs`) covering `Neo.util.Css` without modifying `src/`.
